verse.verse_2: And you are free (from sin, to punish the enemies of Islam on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah).
verse.verse_3: And by the begetter (i.e. Adam) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny);
verse.verse_4: Verily, We have created man in toil.
verse.verse_5: Thinks he that none can overcome him?
verse.verse_6: He says (boastfully): "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"
verse.verse_7: Thinks he that none sees him?
verse.verse_8: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?
verse.verse_9: And a tongue and a pair of lips?
verse.verse_10: And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?
verse.verse_11: But he has made no effort to pass on the path that is steep.
verse.verse_12: And what will make you know the path that is steep?
verse.verse_14: Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine),
verse.verse_15: To an orphan near of kin.
verse.verse_16: Or to a Miskin (poor) afflicted with misery.
verse.verse_17: Then he became one of those who believed, and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.
verse.verse_18: They are those on the Right Hand (the dwellers of Paradise),
verse.verse_19: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).
verse.verse_20: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
